question: Should the release workflow changes and the generated Apple locale refresh land together on this PR, or should the locale refresh remain solely with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110362?
rationale: The two changes have separate owners and validation paths; choosing one carrier prevents duplicate generated changes and lets the CI policy be reviewed independently.

options.title: Split the locale refresh
options.body: Keep this PR focused on release and retry-capacity behavior, land the locale delta through the automation PR, and rebase this branch afterward.

options.title: Land the combined branch
options.body: Accept this PR as the sole carrier only after explicitly superseding the locale-refresh PR and obtaining a post-change retry run.

recommendation.title: Split the locale refresh
recommendation.body: Keep this PR focused on release and retry-capacity behavior, land the locale delta through the automation PR, and rebase this branch afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the release workflow changes and the retry-capacity follow-up, so they are the strongest routing candidate for the landing plan.
